## Description
Briefly describe the change and link any related issues.

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🚀 New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] 🌍 Internationalization / Translation (i18n)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 UI/Styling refinement

## Target Branch
- [ ] Targets `dev` branch (all community PRs must target `dev`)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I have tested this change locally on Linux / Windows / macOS.
- [ ] TypeScript checks pass cleanly (`npm run build`).
- [ ] If AI assistance was used, I have reviewed, verified, and take full responsibility for the code as per `AI_DISCLOSURE.md`.
- [ ] For new translations: verified against `src/locales/en.json`.
